title: hieracium glaucinum subsp. chlorotephrinum
intro: Hieracium glaucinum subsp. chlorotephrinum, commonly known as a type of Hawkweed, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Hieracium glaucinum subsp. chlorotephrinum include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which help in wound healing, reducing fever, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities.
